column7: P95 end-to-end latency < 3000 ms; P99 < 4000 ms; Kinesis DLQ depth = 0; SageMaker endpoint CPU < 70%; Bedrock P95 < 1000 ms
column14: Must pass before Phase 1 go-live; use AWS DLT + Locust
